items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Billy Coleman's bar, the Orchid Bar, they call it, at 125th Street.

ctx.x: The next time we met we met in a bar. A guy that was from Kentucky, but he wasn't a musician. Billy Coleman's bar, the Orchid Bar, they call it, at 125th Street. Then the next time we met, we met with Les Carr, he was a saxophone player, and we met at his house, and then Beeson came, as I told you. I only saw him that once, you know.
